dashboard.label: Snapshot Lab
dashboard.description: Isolated Data Quality Snapshot tile-strip prototype. Same analysis-scope tokens and base searches as Data Intelligence for easy migration.

search.query: | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | stats count by datamodel | sort datamodel

$base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | fields group_value _raw _time _indextime index host source sourcetype tag *

| eval is_json=if(match(_raw,"^\s*[\{\[]"),1,0) | eval is_xml=if(match(_raw,"^\s*<[^>]+>"),1,0) | eval json_payload=if(is_json=1,_raw,null()) | spath input=json_payload | eval schema_fields=null() | foreach * [ eval schema_fields=if( is_json=1 AND isnotnull('<<FIELD>>') AND NOT match("<<FIELD>>","^_") AND NOT match("<<FIELD>>","^(index|source|sourcetype|host|splunk_server|splunk_server_group|linecount|punct|tag|eventtype|group_value|is_json|is_xml|schema_fields)$"), mvappend(schema_fields, lower("<<FIELD>>")), schema_fields ) ] | eval json_schema=if(is_json=1,mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(schema_fields)),"|"),null()) | rex max_match=0 field=_raw "(?:^|\s)(?<kv_pairs>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,100}\s*=\s*(?:\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|[^\s]+))" | rex max_match=0 field=_raw "(?:^|\s)(?<kv_keys>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,100})\s*=" | eval kv_count=mvcount(kv_pairs) | eval is_kv=if(kv_count>=3,1,0) | rex max_match=0 field=_raw "<\/?(?<xml_tags>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*)[\s>/]" | eval is_common_log=if(match(_raw,"^\S+\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+\[[^\]]+\]\s+\"[^\"]*\"\s+\d{3}\s+\S+"),1,0) | eval has_delimiter=if(match(_raw,"[,|;\t]") OR is_common_log=1,1,0) | eval is_delimited=if(is_json=0 AND is_xml=0 AND is_kv=0 AND has_delimiter=1,1,0) | eval delimiter_type=case(is_common_log=1,"common_log",match(_raw,"\|"),"pipe",match(_raw,","),"comma",match(_raw,";"),"semicolon",match(_raw,"\t"),"tab",true(),"none") | eval delimiter_field_count=case(delimiter_type="pipe",mvcount(split(_raw,"|")),delimiter_type="comma",mvcount(split(_raw,",")),delimiter_type="semicolon",mvcount(split(_raw,";")),delimiter_type="tab",mvcount(split(_raw,"\t")),delimiter_type="common_log",9,true(),0) | eval raw_len=len(_raw) | eval fallback_shape=replace(_raw,"\b\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}\b","IP") | eval fallback_shape=replace(fallback_shape,"\b([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){2,}[0-9a-fA-F:]*\b","IP") | eval fallback_shape=replace(fallback_shape,"[A-Fa-f0-9]{8,}","HEX") | eval fallback_shape=replace(fallback_shape,"\d+","N") | eval fallback_shape=trim(replace(fallback_shape,"\s+"," ")) | eval raw_shape=case(is_json=1 AND isnotnull(json_schema) AND len(json_schema)>0,"json_schema:" . json_schema,is_xml=1 AND mvcount(xml_tags)>0,"xml_schema:" . mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(xml_tags)),"|"),is_kv=1 AND mvcount(kv_keys)>0,"kv_keys:" . mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(kv_keys)),"|"),is_delimited=1,"delimited:" . delimiter_type . ":fields=" . delimiter_field_count,true(),"freeform_shape:" . fallback_shape) | eval structure_hint=if(is_json=1 OR is_xml=1 OR is_kv=1 OR is_delimited=1,1,0) | stats count as event_count avg(structure_hint) as structure_ratio dc(raw_shape) as distinct_shapes avg(raw_len) as avg_raw_len stdev(raw_len) as stdev_raw_len by group_value | eval shape_ratio=if(event_count>0,round(distinct_shapes/event_count,4),0) | eval length_variance=if(avg_raw_len>0,round(stdev_raw_len/avg_raw_len,4),0) | eval Classification=case( structure_ratio < 0.20, "Unstructured", structure_ratio >= 0.85 AND shape_ratio <= 0.30, "Structured", structure_ratio >= 0.40 AND shape_ratio <= 0.70, "Semi-Structured", structure_ratio >= 0.40 AND shape_ratio > 0.70, "Inconsistent", true(), "Unstructured" ) | eval Classification_Confidence=case( event_count < 50, "Low sample size", event_count < 250, "Moderate sample size", true(), "Higher sample size" ) | fields group_value event_count structure_ratio shape_ratio length_variance Classification Classification_Confidence

| eval event_time=_time | eval index_time=_indextime | eval ingest_delay_seconds=index_time-event_time | eval ingest_delay_seconds=round(ingest_delay_seconds,0) | eval event_age_at_index_seconds=ingest_delay_seconds | eval index_lag_from_now_seconds=now()-index_time
| eval group_object_type="$group_by$", group_object_name=group_value | lookup telemetry_timeliness_rules object_type AS group_object_type object_name AS group_object_name OUTPUT enabled AS group_enabled healthy_seconds AS group_healthy_seconds warning_seconds AS group_warning_seconds poor_seconds AS group_poor_seconds notes AS group_notes
| eval sourcetype_object_type="sourcetype", sourcetype_object_name=sourcetype | lookup telemetry_timeliness_rules object_type AS sourcetype_object_type object_name AS sourcetype_object_name OUTPUT enabled AS sourcetype_enabled healthy_seconds AS sourcetype_healthy_seconds warning_seconds AS sourcetype_warning_seconds poor_seconds AS sourcetype_poor_seconds notes AS sourcetype_notes
| eval source_object_type="source", source_object_name=source | lookup telemetry_timeliness_rules object_type AS source_object_type object_name AS source_object_name OUTPUT enabled AS source_enabled healthy_seconds AS source_healthy_seconds warning_seconds AS source_warning_seconds poor_seconds AS source_poor_seconds notes AS source_notes
| eval default_object_type="default", default_object_name="*" | lookup telemetry_timeliness_rules object_type AS default_object_type object_name AS default_object_name OUTPUT enabled AS default_enabled healthy_seconds AS default_healthy_seconds warning_seconds AS default_warning_seconds poor_seconds AS default_poor_seconds notes AS default_notes
| eval explicit_disabled=if(group_enabled=0 OR sourcetype_enabled=0 OR source_enabled=0,1,0) | where explicit_disabled!=1 | eval enabled=coalesce(group_enabled,source_enabled,sourcetype_enabled,default_enabled,1) | eval healthy_seconds=tonumber(coalesce(group_healthy_seconds,source_healthy_seconds,sourcetype_healthy_seconds,default_healthy_seconds,300)) | eval warning_seconds=tonumber(coalesce(group_warning_seconds,source_warning_seconds,sourcetype_warning_seconds,default_warning_seconds,1800)) | eval poor_seconds=tonumber(coalesce(group_poor_seconds,source_poor_seconds,sourcetype_poor_seconds,default_poor_seconds,7200)) | eval timeliness_rule_raw_note=coalesce(group_notes,source_notes,sourcetype_notes,default_notes) | eval timeliness_rule_from_lookup=if(isnotnull(group_enabled) OR isnotnull(group_healthy_seconds) OR isnotnull(source_enabled) OR isnotnull(source_healthy_seconds) OR isnotnull(sourcetype_enabled) OR isnotnull(sourcetype_healthy_seconds) OR isnotnull(default_enabled) OR isnotnull(default_healthy_seconds),1,0) | eval timeliness_rule_note=case(timeliness_rule_from_lookup=1 AND len(trim(coalesce(timeliness_rule_raw_note,"")))>0,timeliness_rule_raw_note,timeliness_rule_from_lookup=1,"Rule defined in telemetry_timeliness_rules",true(),"Default thresholds applied") | eval timeliness_rule_source=case(isnotnull(group_enabled) OR isnotnull(group_healthy_seconds), group_object_type . ":" . group_object_name, isnotnull(source_enabled) OR isnotnull(source_healthy_seconds), "source:" . source, isnotnull(sourcetype_enabled) OR isnotnull(sourcetype_healthy_seconds), "sourcetype:" . sourcetype, isnotnull(default_enabled) OR isnotnull(default_healthy_seconds), "default:*", true(), "dashboard fallback") | eval healthy_display=case(healthy_seconds<60,tostring(healthy_seconds) . "s",healthy_seconds<3600,tostring(round(healthy_seconds/60,1)) . "m",healthy_seconds<86400,tostring(round(healthy_seconds/3600,1)) . "h",true(),tostring(round(healthy_seconds/86400,1)) . "d") | eval warning_display=case(warning_seconds<60,tostring(warning_seconds) . "s",warning_seconds<3600,tostring(round(warning_seconds/60,1)) . "m",warning_seconds<86400,tostring(round(warning_seconds/3600,1)) . "h",true(),tostring(round(warning_seconds/86400,1)) . "d") | eval poor_display=case(poor_seconds<60,tostring(poor_seconds) . "s",poor_seconds<3600,tostring(round(poor_seconds/60,1)) . "m",poor_seconds<86400,tostring(round(poor_seconds/3600,1)) . "h",true(),tostring(round(poor_seconds/86400,1)) . "d") | eval expected_range="Healthy <=" . tostring(healthy_seconds) . "s (" . healthy_display . "), Warning >" . tostring(healthy_seconds) . "s and <=" . tostring(warning_seconds) . "s (" . warning_display . "), Poor >" . tostring(warning_seconds) . "s and <=" . tostring(poor_seconds) . "s (" . poor_display . "), Critical >" . tostring(poor_seconds) . "s (" . poor_display . ")" | eval old_event_seconds=2592000 | eval future_skew_seconds=300 | where enabled!=0
| eval delay_category=case( ingest_delay_seconds < 0, "Future timestamp", ingest_delay_seconds <= healthy_seconds, "Healthy", ingest_delay_seconds <= warning_seconds, "Warning", ingest_delay_seconds <= poor_seconds, "Poor", true(), "Critical" ) | eval timestamp_indicator=case( ingest_delay_seconds < 0, "Future timestamp", ingest_delay_seconds > old_event_seconds, "Old event at index time", true(), "Within configured bounds" ) | eval ingest_delay_display=case( abs(ingest_delay_seconds) < 60, tostring(ingest_delay_seconds) . "s", abs(ingest_delay_seconds) < 3600, tostring(round(ingest_delay_seconds/60,1)) . "m", abs(ingest_delay_seconds) < 86400, tostring(round(ingest_delay_seconds/3600,1)) . "h", true(), tostring(round(ingest_delay_seconds/86400,1)) . "d" ) | eval event_time_readable=strftime(event_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval index_time_readable=strftime(index_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval raw_preview=if(len(_raw)>500, substr(_raw,1,500) . " ... [TRUNCATED]", _raw) | fields _time event_time index_time event_time_readable index_time_readable index host source sourcetype group_value ingest_delay_seconds ingest_delay_display delay_category timestamp_indicator healthy_seconds warning_seconds poor_seconds healthy_display warning_display poor_display old_event_seconds future_skew_seconds timeliness_rule_source expected_range timeliness_rule_note raw_preview _raw

| eval structure_score=round(structure_ratio*100,0) | eval consistency_score=round(max(0,min(100,100-(shape_ratio*100)-(length_variance*25))),0) | stats avg(structure_score) as Structure avg(consistency_score) as Consistency | eval Structure=round(Structure,0), Consistency=round(Consistency,0) | fields Structure Consistency

| fieldsummary maxvals=1 | rename field as field_name | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | where NOT match(field_name,"^_") | where NOT match(field_name,"^(host|source|sourcetype|index|splunk_server|splunk_server_group|linecount|punct|eventtype|constraint|group_value|tag)$") | join type=left max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval scope_field=case( "$field_scope$"="all",1, "$field_scope$"="recommended" AND (recommended=1 OR required=1),1, true(),0 ) | where scope_field=1 | stats count as scope_hit by field_name ] | eval matched=if(isnotnull(scope_hit),1,0) | stats dc(field_name) as current_fields sum(matched) as matched_scope_fields | eval cim_overlap_pct=round(if(current_fields>0,(matched_scope_fields/current_fields)*100,0),0) | fields cim_overlap_pct current_fields matched_scope_fields

| where delay_category!="Future timestamp" | stats count as total_events count(eval(delay_category="Healthy")) as healthy_events median(ingest_delay_seconds) as median_lag | eval healthy_pct=round(if(total_events>0,(healthy_events/total_events)*100,0),0) | eval median_lag_display=case( isnull(median_lag), "n/a", abs(median_lag) < 60, tostring(round(median_lag,0)) . "s", abs(median_lag) < 3600, tostring(round(median_lag/60,1)) . "m", abs(median_lag) < 86400, tostring(round(median_lag/3600,1)) . "h", true(), tostring(round(median_lag/86400,1)) . "d" ) | fields healthy_pct median_lag_display total_events healthy_events

| eventstats values(tag) as observed_tags | fields observed_tags * | fields - _raw _time _indextime _cd _serial linecount punct splunk_server splunk_server_group | untable observed_tags field_name field_value | where isnotnull(field_value) | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | where NOT match(field_name,"^_") | where field_name!="observed_tags" | stats count as field_instances values(observed_tags) as observed_tags by field_name | join type=inner max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval scope_field=case( "$field_scope$"="all",1, "$field_scope$"="recommended" AND (recommended=1 OR required=1),1, true(),0 ) | where scope_field=1 | fields datamodel field_name scope_field ] | stats dc(field_name) as matched_scope_fields values(observed_tags) as observed_tags by datamodel | join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval scope_field=case( "$field_scope$"="all",1, "$field_scope$"="recommended" AND (recommended=1 OR required=1),1, true(),0 ) | where scope_field=1 | stats dc(field_name) as total_scope_fields by datamodel ] | eval datamodel_key=case( lower(datamodel)="inventory","Compute_Inventory", lower(datamodel)="java virtual machines","JVM", true(),replace(datamodel," ","_") ) | eval observed_tags=mvmap(observed_tags, lower(trim(observed_tags))) | join type=left max=0 datamodel_key [ | inputlookup cim_datamodel_tags_lookup | eval datamodel_key=case( lower(datamodel)="inventory","Compute_Inventory", lower(datamodel)="java virtual machines","JVM", true(),replace(datamodel," ","_") ) | eval expected_tag=lower(trim(expected_tag)) | eval tag_role=lower(trim(coalesce(tag_role,"supporting"))) | eval coverage_set=coalesce(coverage_set,"_default") | where tag_role="top_level" | fields datamodel_key expected_tag tag_role coverage_set ] | eval tag_hit=if(isnotnull(expected_tag) AND mvfind(observed_tags, expected_tag)>=0,1,0) | stats min(eval(if(tag_role="top_level",tag_hit,null()))) as top_ok max(matched_scope_fields) as matched_scope_fields max(total_scope_fields) as total_scope_fields by datamodel coverage_set | eval set_complete=if(isnull(top_ok),0,if(top_ok=1,1,0)) | stats max(set_complete) as top_level_tag_observed max(matched_scope_fields) as matched_scope_fields max(total_scope_fields) as total_scope_fields by datamodel | eval field_alignment_pct=if(total_scope_fields>0,round((matched_scope_fields/total_scope_fields)*100,2),0) | eval current_alignment_pct=if(top_level_tag_observed=1,field_alignment_pct,0) | eval potential_alignment_pct=if(top_level_tag_observed=0,field_alignment_pct,0) | where current_alignment_pct>0 OR potential_alignment_pct>0 | stats sum(eval(if(current_alignment_pct>0,1,0))) as current_dm_count sum(eval(if(potential_alignment_pct>0,1,0))) as potential_dm_count | eval current_dm_count=coalesce(current_dm_count,0) | eval potential_dm_count=coalesce(potential_dm_count,0) | fields current_dm_count potential_dm_count

div.div: Prototype tile strip for the Data Quality Snapshot. Same Analysis Scope tokens as Data Intelligence. Sign off here before swapping the live chart.

div.p: What this shows: Traffic-light indicators for structure, consistency, CIM field overlap, delivery lag, and datamodel Current vs Potential counts.
Why it matters: A strip is easier to scan than four 0–100 bars and points to what to investigate next in DIG IN.
Read it as: An indicator, not a certification. Threshold bands are provisional until confirmed. Datamodel tile is Green when Current ≥ 1.

html.div: Compare side-by-side with Data Intelligence (existing column chart). After sign-off, migrate the mount + tile searches onto that dashboard and remove this lab view.
